source_delta.change: After server readiness, capture llama-server /props, bind the started process executable path/hash, resolve the server-reported model_path, hash the post-load GGUF path, and write CLAY_LOCAL_RESEARCH_MODEL/v2 state. Existing already-running processes are explicitly recorded as identity-partial rather than silently treated as bound.

problem_observed: The first local Qwen3-4B/llama.cpp launcher wrote STARTING state before exec and then never produced a post-load exact runtime/model identity record. That left model/runtime reproducibility weaker than the current HCU J-Space intervention gate requires.

external_donor_observation.llama_cpp_models: llama.cpp documents -hf <user>/<model>[:quant] as a supported Hugging Face load path.
external_donor_observation.llama_cpp_props: llama-server documents GET /props as exposing model_path and build_info for the running server.
external_donor_observation.qwen_selector: Qwen/Qwen3-4B-GGUF documents the Q4_K_M llama.cpp selector used by the local launcher.

evidence_scope.loader_consumption_note: A model_path observed from /props after load plus a post-load file hash is stronger than a pre-load hash, but it is not proof of the exact bytes consumed by the loader and does not close post-load mutation risk.

go_tracks.track_a: ADVANCED_SOURCE_CONVERGENCE: local provider-independent inference now has a stronger post-load identity record suitable for downstream exact execution receipts.
go_tracks.track_b: ADVANCED_REUSABLE_HCU_IDENTITY_PRIMITIVE: runtime binary identity and post-load model-path identity are now emitted explicitly without creating a second truth authority.
go_tracks.track_c: ADVANCED_TRAINING_READINESS_PREREQUISITE_ONLY: the local Qwen lane now emits checkpoint/runtime identity evidence needed before any model-specific J-Space intervention receipt, while remaining explicitly noncausal and nontraining evidence.

unusual_experiment: COORDINATION_BLOCKED_NO_UNUSUAL_EXPERIMENT: no shared reproducible immutable macrocycle identity is exposed to this organ, so no new unusual intervention was attempted.
next_exact_action: On an authorized exposed local normal-user or clay-direct-dev bridge, run the committed launcher, verify CLAY_LOCAL_RESEARCH_MODEL/v2 reaches READY_IDENTITY_OBSERVED with non-null runtime binary and GGUF hashes, then continue to the smallest clean/corrupted/target/sham J-Space intervention family while preserving loader-consumption as UNKNOWN until separately attested.
